subject: Temporary SLA routing & escalation playbook request — AtlasPay settlement incidents
messages:
From: Imran Malik <imran@atlaspay.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com
Cc: ops@atlaspay.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recurrent late-night settlements — request for temporary SLA routing/escalation

Avery,

We had another late-night failure in the settlement pipeline (01:40 UTC) that delayed multiple merchant batches. This is the third similar incident in the past two weeks during the 00:30–04:30 UTC window. Each time the initial P1 hit our on-call, but follow-up handling and rerouting didn't happen quickly enough and we saw extended retries from our side.

Can Redwood temporarily route AtlasPay traffic to a higher-priority pool during the 00:00–06:00 UTC window while we investigate root cause? We also need a clear escalation playbook and a single on-call escalation contact for P1s that impact settlement throughput.

I've attached the incident log for tonight. We need this in writing by EOD tomorrow so our procurement/legal teams can approve the temporary change.

Thanks,
Imran Malik
Head of Platform Operations
AtlasPay

[attachment: incident_log_2026-09-28.csv (csv, 48KB)]

From: avery_johnson@redwood.com
To: imran@atlaspay.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recurrent late-night settlements — request for temporary SLA routing/escalation

Imran — thanks for the note and the log. I'm sorry AtlasPay is seeing this disruption. We'll prioritize this.

Quick plan we can move on immediately:
- Internal alignment: loop in on-call/ops and CS to draft a temporary routing + escalation playbook
- Technical mitigation: Vivek, can we stage a higher-tier route for 00:00–06:00 UTC starting tonight through Friday while Atlas and we investigate?
- Contracts/credits: Neha, can you confirm whether a temporary SLA alteration requires an amendment/credit?
- Deliverable: I'll get a written playbook and a contact list to you by EOD tomorrow, and we can sign-off over DocuSign if needed.

Imran — is AtlasPay comfortable with Redwood initiating routing changes on our side (we won't change anything on your side) while retaining normal logging and audit trails?

—Avery
Avery Johnson
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com, imran@atlaspay.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recurrent late-night settlements — request for temporary SLA routing/escalation

On Mon, Sep 28, 2026 at 10:03 AM Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com> wrote:
> Imran — thanks for the note and the log. I'm sorry AtlasPay is seeing this disruption. We'll prioritize this.

We can do a temporary routing override. Proposed technical parameters:
- Window: 00:00–06:00 UTC (configurable per night)
- Route: escalate AtlasPay traffic to Dedicated Pool C (higher GPU priority / reserved burst capacity)
- Targets: P1 initial ack target = 30 minutes; P1 full response/triage = 2 hours; P2 ack = 2 hours; P2 full response = 8 hours
- TTL: short-term policy for 7 nights with auto-review on day 5
- Audit: all routed requests will be tagged and logged; we'll provide a filtered audit export nightly

Open items from infra side: capacity cost delta if we keep override nightly; we'll need a formal approval to consume Dedicated Pool C for the specified hours. Also want sign-off that AtlasPay accepts the proposed P1/P2 numeric targets for the temporary window.

I'll attach a concise proposal doc for Ops to review.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head, Global Oncall & Reliability
Redwood Inference

[attachment: SLA_Route_Proposal_v2.pdf (pdf, 240KB)]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 13:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recurrent late-night settlements — request for temporary SLA routing/escalation

Avery / team — adding support perspective.

If we approve the Dedicated Pool routing:
- Ben/Support will set up a separate P1 playbook for the night window with a single escalation phone/SMS list (Tier 1: on-call, Tier 2: Vivek, Tier 3: Avery)
- We'll create a dedicated Slack channel with push alerts for AtlasPay P1s during the window
- For customer-facing comms: Monica, can CS own the notification to AtlasPay merchant ops when we flip the routing? That reduces confusion.

Note on SLAs and credits: Any formal change to SLA terms needs Neha's sign-off and likely an amendment. If AtlasPay agrees to the temporary numeric targets, we can offer a pro-rated credit language in the amendment in case the temporary window experiences a missed P1.

—Ben

From: Imran Malik <imran@atlaspay.com>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: ops@atlaspay.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recurrent late-night settlements — request for temporary SLA routing/escalation

Thanks, everyone. AtlasPay is agreeable to the temporary routing to Dedicated Pool C for the next seven nights while we continue root-cause work. Two asks before we sign anything:
1) We need a written escalation playbook that includes names/phone numbers and the exact criteria that elevate an event to P1 vs P2 (so our ops can triage consistently).
2) Data residency / audit question: will the temporary route change move any payloads outside of our configured region? We must keep settlement data in the US region per our contract.

If those two items are confirmed, we'll sign the short-term amendment tonight and provide DocuSign back.

—Imran

On Tue, Sep 29, 2026 at 08:18 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> We can guarantee region-pinning; Dedicated Pool C is in our us-central region and will not leave the US.

From: avery_johnson@redwood.com
To: imran@atlaspay.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recurrent late-night settlements — request for temporary SLA routing/escalation

Imran — follow-up / summary and next steps.

Summary (approved):
- Start: 2026-09-30 00:00 UTC window (redwood-controlled routing flip tonight)
- Duration: nightly 00:00–06:00 UTC for 7 nights (auto-review on night 5)
- Targets for the temporary window: P1 ack = 30m, P1 triage = 2h, P2 ack = 2h, P2 triage = 8h
- Route: AtlasPay traffic -> Dedicated Pool C (us-central) — region pinning confirmed by Vivek
- Escalation: Tier 1 on-call -> Tier 2 Vivek Kulkarni -> Tier 3 Avery Johnson; Ben will own phone/SMS list and Slack channel; Monica will notify AtlasPay merchant ops when flip happens
- Contract: Neha will draft a 7-night amendment that documents the temporary targets and a pro-rated credit clause if temporary targets are missed

Deliverables and owners:
- SLA playbook doc (with phone numbers & P1/P2 criteria) — Ben (draft by 18:00 PDT today)
- Amendment (DocuSign-ready) — Neha (draft by 10:00 PDT tomorrow)
- Routing flip and audit stream — Vivek / Infra (flip tonight; nightly audit export to AtlasPay ops)

Imran — please confirm you'd like Redwood to flip tonight so we can proceed. Once you confirm, Ben and Vivek will execute and Monica will send the customer-facing notification.

Thanks all — I'll follow up after tonight's flip with the playbook and the first audit export link.

—Avery
Avery Johnson
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
